main_text.p: efferentium, procellis hausti & demersi (siccum enim mare Syrtes exhibent, quod ventis agitatum, pro fluctibus arenarum cumulos versat) Horum tandem malorum impatientes, ad arma conclamare, turmatim concurrere, in Austrum, quasi in hostem (agilem illum, & ordines intercurrere subtilem) saxis & telis irruere: Sed ita furentes, & (quod hîc verè dixeris, aërem verberantes, adverso turbine violentior ventus occupat, & dicto citius, universos cum omnibus copiis armisque, collibus arenarum involvit & sepelit. Silet hic Genius noster; sed si staret ad plebe-

page.notes: Left margin fragments of the facing page are cut off and not legible enough to transcribe. The running head is rendered in small capitals. The line "plebe-" is a catchword-like hyphenated line break continuing onto the next page; not a catchword. Some letters are uncertain due to scan quality (e.g. "dixeris" and "hîc").
